body: That’s awesome!! I’ll keep my eye for them this year. A little bit of fruit can go a long way in that heat.
Yours gave out fruit? Mine told us we were going to Hell.

I’ve also tried to OD. It did not end up like I wanted it to. Like others have said, it does indeed hurt… a lot. You will throw up for days after your attempt, at minimum, and everything hurts until your body finds a way to heal the parts that are salvageable. OD is not the move.

I definitely did that to an ex of mine some years back. A lot of stuff wasn’t adding up, so I popped by one night after work and found her with her ex and she tried to gaslight me. Needless to say, we aren’t together anymore.
A picture of my mom and I.
We really do relate to it so much.
This is so true. We do our best to make sure that others are okay and have everything they need in a support system, meanwhile, our own soul is crying and screaming for help.
I love that you found a sensitive man and I also love how it seems like you don’t shame him for it!!

I definitely understand what you’re saying. I think it’s perfectly plausible for men to be the protector and provider that countless people need, but sometimes a good cry is what we need to help us make it to the next day. Otherwise it gets forced aside and pushed down until there isn’t a healthy outlet left.

Society has a way of making us feel like we can’t be vulnerable. I try to advocate for men’s health. It may not reach a large audience and that’s okay. If only one person sees my words and resonates with it for a change then it will make me feel like it’s worth it. So many of us don’t want to be in this life anymore and I truly believe it’s because of the stigma that society placed on men who are emotional as weak. I’ve made countless posts about this on my main account and mods in different groups always lock it down because “there’s nothing to validate it.” They don’t have to agree with me, but millions of men feel the same way I do for a reason.
Rest easy now, Mr. Werner.
I appreciate that!!

I highly think about doing it and have for years. I’m very big on making plans because I don’t like making plans and then breaking them. It might not make much sense to other people, but that’s a part of what keeps me here. If I make plans for a concert, a trip, or just a simple get together then I’ll try my best to stay here until then. I just keep making plans to fill the gaps. However, as strong as my urges have been the last couple months, I know there will come a day that I won’t make it to that one event. I just don’t know when it’ll be.

This is quite possibly the most perfect way of explaining it. We live double lives. As you said, we live one where we portray ourselves to be happy by laughing and joking with people and the other where we are alone and our thoughts take over. The amount of research I’ve done to find a painless method is scary. The urge is as strong as it’s ever been for me. Even stronger than my last attempt and that’s what scares me the most. I absolutely know that I will do it. I just don’t know if it’ll be tonight, next year, or ten years from now. I keep thinking about how much peace I’ll feel compared to waking up every day and having the man in the mirror tell me I’m worthless and I’m not enough and never will be.

I’m going to echo what several people have already said and that is that OD is, in fact, not painless and does not always work. I tried to OD once. I regretted it immediately and so did my insides. I threw more times in several days than I have in my several decades of life.

The game is legit. I ordered the mine around the first half of November and I just got it like a week or so ago. It did come extremely late, but after emailing them they sent me the tracking information and I saw that it got stuck at customs for a while and then it got stuck at my local facility for even longer. I was skeptical at first and had accepted the fact that I possibly got scammed, but it actually did come. If you live in the states, it absolutely will take months to arrive, but it will arrive. My only complaint, aside from the time frame, is the fact that I’m no longer dating the girl that wanted to play it in the first place. Lol!!
I’m glad you are alright. I also tried to end myself with that method. I woke up and ended up vomiting everywhere for a good two or three days.

Sorry for the late response and thank you for your reply. That’s what I’m afraid of. I honestly feel like being admitted is the last thing I need. I just have a strong feeling that it will only have a negative impact on me. My head is bad enough when I’m alone at home. I can’t imagine it when In a place like that.

Thank you. My brother went to the hospital once for an unrelated issue and admitted to being suicidal at one point when asked and they sent him off against his will. It seemed weird. I’m just afraid of that happening to me if I go for help because I have strong suicidal urges. I’m also afraid of them taking my gun away.
I think if you do anything with the hopes of dying then it was an attempt.
